Plot observed against predicted for a validation manifest

Source: R/validate.R
apsim_validation_plot.Rd

Builds an observed-versus-predicted scatter with the 1:1 line, titled with the verdict and key metrics. Requires the optional ggplot2 package; returns an apsim_abstention() when it is absent.

Usage

apsim_validation_plot(validation)

Arguments

validation

An apsim_manifest of inferential_target = "validation" (the result of apsim_validate()).

Value

A ggplot object, or an apsim_abstention.

Examples

v <- apsim_validate(c(2, 3.6, 3.8, 5), c(2.1, 3.4, 4, 5.2))
apsim_validation_plot(v)
